aggregation: Extend stable same-fragment linear bases into poorly supported cut regions. Keep all material volumes. Exact reduced inertia E.T diag(m) E; never relump after aggregation. No cross-fragment source or erasure of history.
transfer: Mass-orthogonal state projection, with explicit measured projection errors/energy; no hidden resets, energy correction impulses or loss labelled fracture.
stage_A: Before speed optimization: rank/rigid/energy/force/mass checks, corner-spectrum sweep, state projection and independent fragment tests, half-step comparisons and drift against preserved v17 trajectories.
stage_B: Only after A: GPU reduced dynamics and local incremental cut-history updates. Benchmark 60mm body and cut-history; no inference of RL from bulk-only speed.
stage_C: Only if credible speed: contact fixture integration, reaction/penetration/force/work and combined loop measurement; physical fracture not inherited from geometric cuts.
stop: Stop substantive failed gate with concrete diagnosis. One bounded diagnosed correction is allowed within same approved model; no automatic new engine/XPBD switch, mass scaling, material deletion or relaxed accuracy.
